tools.definition_version: DICOM 2026b official DocBook parts 3, 4, and 6 transformed into locked dicom-validator JSON definitions
tools.notes: Case-scoped secondary IOD and ordered raw payload validator for Twelve-lead and General ECG Waveform Storage. It supplements rather than replaces dicom3tools. General ECG qualification accepted the exact valid two-group prototype and both IOD validators rejected missing conditional skews. Both IOD validators missed five groups, 25 channels, 199/1001 Hz, unsigned US interpretation, wrong and duplicated CID 3001 identities, sample-count arithmetic, reversed group order, and a changed payload byte. The waveform route rejected every mutation and independently extracts each raw OW value with pydicom and signed samples with Python struct, enforcing ordered shapes, formula, interleave, channel definitions, group and channel hashes, and aggregate hash without project generator code or NumPy. Set DTS_DICOM_VALIDATOR_PYTHON and DTS_DICOM_VALIDATOR_STANDARD_HOME; every runtime and definition input contributes to the composite adapter fingerprint.
